item.title: Hayden Adams Details Auto-Compounding Liquidity Design for Pools.trade Platform
item.summary: Uniswap founder Hayden Adams detailed an auto-compounding liquidity mechanism he designed for pools.trade, contrasting it with thin-curve launchpad approaches, and stated the design 'would work for autocompounding regular Uniswap LP positions too' and that 'we're adding it to the roadmap' — a personal claim on X not yet confirmed by official Uniswap channels.
